04902 Meshek {meh'-shek}

和 04901 有相同的形式, 但是可能源自外來語; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Meshech 8, Mesech 1; 9

米設 = "拉長"
1) 雅弗的兒子, 挪亞的孫子, 北方以色列居民的始祖
   1a) 米設的後裔常用於與"土巴","瑪各", 和其他北方民族(包括"柯爾奇斯"和"亞美尼亞"邊境的居民Moschi)相提並論

2) 閃的一個後代也是此名  （#代上 1:17|）
record.edic_text:
04902 Meshek {meh'-shek}

the same in form as 04901, but probably of foreign derivation;; n pr m

AV - Meshech 8, Mesech 1; 9

Mesech or Meshech = "drawing out"
1) son of Japheth, grandson of Noah, and progenitor of peoples to the
   north of Israel
   1a) descendants of Mesech often mentioned in connection with Tubal,
       Magog, and other northern nations including the Moschi, a
       people on the borders of Colchis and Armenia
